description: A compact JWS ".UGF5bG9hZA.<sig>" whose protected part is empty, with the HS256 MAC over ".UGF5bG9hZA" correct (HMAC computed with Python hmac/hashlib under the RFC 7515 A.1 key): the empty part decodes to zero octets, which are not JSON, so the JWS Protected Header fails to parse: InvalidJson (RFC 7515 §5.2 step 3; ADR 0048 step 3). This differs on purpose from the JSON serialization, where "protected": "" is InvalidFormat because RFC 7515 §7.2.1 requires the member to be absent when the protected header is empty, a shape violation (ADR 0026 §1)
